The '''Dalicron system''' was a star system in the [[Dalicron sector/Legends|Dalicron sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] was located in the system and was settled by colonists about 800 years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
